clinical_guidelines: The document discusses the management of traumatic aortic injuries, with a focus on blunt traumatic aortic injury (BTAI) and blunt traumatic abdominal aortic injury (BAAI).
Different management approaches include immediate repair, endovascular repair, and nonoperative management.
Sections outline strategies for initial management of BTAI and BAAI, endovascular versus open surgical repair, and long-term management/surveillance after aortic injury.
It covers trauma scoring in patients with thoracic aortic injury and predictive models for in-hospital mortality.
A classification scheme for treating blunt aortic injury tailored to the individual patient is described.
The document includes statistical analyses and reviews of several studies and trials in relation to aortic repair techniques.
